and order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') and customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%') and material_code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%') and order_date = #{orderDate}
order by order_date desc, order_id desc

select o.order_no as orderNo, date_format(max(o.order_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as orderDate, max(o.customer_name) as customerName, count(*) as lineCount, sum(o.quantity) as quantity, sum(o.amount) as amount, date_format(max(o.delivery_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as deliveryDate, ifnull(max(w.wo_count), 0) as workOrderCount, ifnull(max(w.planned_qty), 0) as plannedQty, ifnull(max(f.coil_count), 0) as finishCoilCount, ifnull(max(f.finish_weight), 0) as finishWeight, ifnull(max(s.ship_count), 0) as shipmentCount, ifnull(max(s.ship_weight), 0) as shipWeight from ord_sale_order o left join ( select order_no, count(*) as wo_count, sum(quantity) as planned_qty from prod_work_order group by order_no ) w on w.order_no = o.order_no left join ( select order_no, count(*) as coil_count, sum(net_weight) as finish_weight from inv_finish_coil group by order_no ) f on f.order_no = o.order_no left join ( select s1.order_no, count(distinct s1.shipment_id) as ship_count, sum(i.net_weight) as ship_weight from inv_shipment s1 inner join inv_shipment_item i on i.shipment_id = s1.shipment_id group by s1.order_no ) s on s.order_no = o.order_no
and o.order_no like concat('%', #{orderNo}, '%') and o.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and o.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%')
group by o.order_no order by orderDate desc
